# What is Malachyte

Learn what Malachyte is and how to integrate it into an e-commerce system

Malachyte is a real-time individualization platform for modern commerce. It uses an AI-driven intelligence engine, MiQ, to understand shopper intent and adapt digital experiences instantly—even for completely anonymous shoppers.

Unlike legacy tools that rely on static segments or overnight batch updates, Malachyte processes behavior in milliseconds to ensure every interaction is relevant to the individual’s current context.

* * *

## [Core Concepts](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#core-concepts)

### [Real-time Individualization](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#real-time-individualization)

While traditional personalization groups shoppers into broad segments, Malachyte individualizes. It focuses on the unique path of a single shopper, responding to clicks, scrolls, and searches as they happen.

### [Adaptive User Profiles](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#adaptive-user-profiles)

Malachyte builds Adaptive User Profiles for 100% of a site's traffic. This approach ensures that intelligence is applied to every shopper, regardless of their history.

- Cold Start Activation: Intelligence begins the moment a shopper arrives. No previous history, login, or cookies are required to start personalizing.
- In-Session Learning: Profiles evolve within a single session, refining recommendations as intent becomes clearer.
- Long-Term Memory: MiQ doesn't reset after a session. It builds a persistent understanding that compounds value over time across sessions and seasons.

### [The MiQ Engine](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#the-miq-engine)

MiQ is the "brain" behind the platform. It is a plug-and-play intelligence engine designed by the team that built Spotify’s personalization infrastructure. It balances short-term engagement with long-term business objectives, ensuring that every decision contributes to compounding ROI.

* * *

## [How Malachyte Works](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#how-malachyte-works)

Malachyte acts as an intelligent layer between a client's data signals and its shopper-facing surfaces.

1. Ingest Signals: Malachyte tracks real-time signals.
2. Generate Intelligence: The MiQ engine processes these signals to update the Adaptive User Profile instantly.
3. Deliver Experiences: The platform powers individualized content across the entire journey—from the homepage and search results to category pages and product details.
4. Continuous Optimization: As more data flows through the system, the AI learns across shoppers, improving accuracy and revenue per visitor (RPV) while keeping customer acquisition costs (CAC) flat.

## [Control through the Portal](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#control-through-the-portal)

Malachyte is designed to be a "copilot" for client teams, not a black box. Through the Malachyte Portal, merchandisers and marketers can:

- Set Strategies: Align AI decisions with business goals like inventory clearance or high-margin prioritization.
- Explainability: Use real-time tags to see _why_ the AI made a specific recommendation.
- Smart Guardrails: Override or fine-tune experiences instantly without needing engineering support.

Each client has their own Malachyte Portal URL (for example, `https://acme.malachyte.com/login`), shared during onboarding.

![A visual of the onboarding screen within the Malachyte Portal](https://docs.malachyte.com/_next/image?url=%2F_next%2Fstatic%2Fmedia%2Fportal_onboarding_screen.691d8723.png&w=3840&q=75&dpl=dpl_Co9tkg3hsL2tcf6GKvMmLz45Hgxv)

* * *

## [Integration and Scale](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/what-is-malachyte\#integration-and-scale)

- Plug-and-Play API: Connect to any surface with minimal development. Most teams can activate a "Golden Path Pilot" in days.
- Performance at Scale: Built for minimal latency to ensure that personalization never slows down the site.
- Privacy by Design: Malachyte is built to function with a minimal data footprint, focusing on behavioral intent rather than harvesting personal information.
